GRADE 8 INTEGRATED SCIENCE — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: INTEGRATED SCIENCE
Time: 64 minutes

INSTRUCTIONS
1. This is an advanced revision paper.
2. Show working where needed.
3. Answer all questions.
2. For multiple choice, write the correct letter only.
3. For short answers, write clearly in the spaces provided.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A: Multiple Choice

1. About Elements and Compounds in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. explain the relationship between an atom, an element, a molecule and a compound,
   B. Learners should ignore Elements and Compounds completely.
   C. Elements and Compounds is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Elements and Compounds.

2. About Elements and Compounds around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. assign symbols to selected elements,
   B. Learners should ignore Elements and Compounds completely.
   C. Elements and Compounds is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Elements and Compounds.

3. About Elements and Compounds in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. write word equations to represent reactions of selected elements to form compounds,
   B. Learners should ignore Elements and Compounds completely.
   C. Elements and Compounds is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Elements and Compounds.

5. About Physical and chemical changes in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. describe the characteristics of particles in the three states of matter,
   B. Learners should ignore Physical and chemical changes completely.
   C. Physical and chemical changes is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Physical and chemical changes.

6. About Physical and chemical changes around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. explain the effects of impurities on boiling point and melting point of a substance,
   B. Learners should ignore Physical and chemical changes completely.
   C. Physical and chemical changes is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Physical and chemical changes.

7. About Physical and chemical changes in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. distinguish between physical and chemical changes in substances,
   B. Learners should ignore Physical and chemical changes completely.
   C. Physical and chemical changes is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Physical and chemical changes.

9. About Classes of fire in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. identify causes of fire in nature,
   B. Learners should ignore Classes of fire completely.
   C. Classes of fire is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Classes of fire.

10. About Classes of fire around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. explain the role of the components of fire triangle in the spread of fire,
   B. Learners should ignore Classes of fire completely.
   C. Classes of fire is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Classes of fire.

11. About Classes of fire in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. describe ways of controlling different classes of fires,
   B. Learners should ignore Classes of fire completely.
   C. Classes of fire is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Classes of fire.

13. About The Cell in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. describe the structure of plant and animal cells as observed under a light microscope,
   B. Learners should ignore The Cell completely.
   C. The Cell is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise The Cell.

14. About The Cell around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. describe the functions of components of cells seen under the light microscope,
   B. Learners should ignore The Cell completely.
   C. The Cell is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise The Cell.

15. About The Cell in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. compare plant and animal cells as observed under a light microscope,
   B. Learners should ignore The Cell completely.
   C. The Cell is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise The Cell.

17. About Movement of Materials in and out of the cell in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. outline the process of diffusion and osmosis in cells,
   B. Learners should ignore Movement of Materials in and out of the cell completely.
   C. Movement of Materials in and out of the cell is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Movement of Materials in and out of the cell.

18. About Movement of Materials in and out of the cell around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. demonstrate diffusion and osmosis in living things,
   B. Learners should ignore Movement of Materials in and out of the cell completely.
   C. Movement of Materials in and out of the cell is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Movement of Materials in and out of the cell.

19. About Movement of Materials in and out of the cell in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. explain the role of diffusion and osmosis in living things,
   B. Learners should ignore Movement of Materials in and out of the cell completely.
   C. Movement of Materials in and out of the cell is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Movement of Materials in and out of the cell.

21. About Reproduction in human beings in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. outline the menstrual cycle and its related challenges in human beings,
   B. Learners should ignore Reproduction in human beings completely.
   C. Reproduction in human beings is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reproduction in human beings.

22. About Reproduction in human beings around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. develop a plan to manage challenges related to menstrual cycle in human beings,
   B. Learners should ignore Reproduction in human beings completely.
   C. Reproduction in human beings is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reproduction in human beings.

23. About Reproduction in human beings in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. describe fertilisation and implantation in human beings,
   B. Learners should ignore Reproduction in human beings completely.
   C. Reproduction in human beings is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reproduction in human beings.

25. About Transformation of Energy in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. identify forms of energy in nature,
   B. Learners should ignore Transformation of Energy completely.
   C. Transformation of Energy is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Transformation of Energy.

26. About Transformation of Energy around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. classify energy sources into renewable or non- renewable,
   B. Learners should ignore Transformation of Energy completely.
   C. Transformation of Energy is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Transformation of Energy.

27. About Transformation of Energy in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. demonstrate simple energy transformations in nature,
   B. Learners should ignore Transformation of Energy completely.
   C. Transformation of Energy is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Transformation of Energy.

29. About Pressure in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. demonstrate pressure in solids and liquids,
   B. Learners should ignore Pressure completely.
   C. Pressure is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Pressure.

30. About Pressure around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. identify applications of pressure in solids and liquids,
   B. Learners should ignore Pressure completely.
   C. Pressure is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Pressure.

31. About Pressure in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. demonstrate pressure in solids and liquids,
   B. Learners should ignore Pressure completely.
   C. Pressure is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Pressure.

SECTION B: Short Answers

4. Give two examples of how you can use Elements and Compounds in your school compound.

8. Give two examples of how you can use Physical and chemical changes in your school compound.

12. Give two examples of how you can use Classes of fire in your school compound.

16. Give two examples of how you can use The Cell in your school compound.

20. Give two examples of how you can use Movement of Materials in and out of the cell in your school compound.

24. Give two examples of how you can use Reproduction in human beings in your school compound.

28. Give two examples of how you can use Transformation of Energy in your school compound.

32. Give two examples of how you can use Pressure in your school compound.
